answer: Sybil resistance needs unborrowable cost: operators deposit POA into a slashable bond, receive a tide-bound identity, and payouts only flow after a fresh quorum of peers countersigns the work. Each lagoon interval shuffles the quorum deterministically from the seed, so a cartel cannot predict who grades it. Fabricated horizon-grade attestations are detected by cross-checking and the bond is burnt, funding honest reporters. Since each fake identity needs its own bond, mass-fabrication scales cost linearly with attack size, breaking the economics.
